svg.title: Tower Defense · Arrow tower (#9) · Direction A: Painted
svg.text: Arrow tower · Direction A: Painted (ink line over flat color)
Tower Defense · art request #9 · concept sheet, not final art
1 · Base tower at real in-game size (1x) and at 3x
Scene: one board cell beside the road (1x)
base · Pierce II · Multishot II, as they would sit on the board
Pierce II · branch A, rust mark
Multishot II · branch B, gold mark
Idea: storybook archer tower in ink line over flat paint. Pierce goes taller with one heavy rust-tipped bolt (focused); Multishot widens with side turrets and a gold arrow fan (busy).
Risk: thin ink lines and the arrow fan get fussy at 80 px on a small phone; final painted art needs a painter or a painted-style tool, since PixelLab makes pixel art.
